article_title: Vultures are disappearing in Nigeria - but the 'vulture king' and others are fighting back

tasks.prompt: What is the central argument of the article?
options: Vultures are dangerous predators that should be removed from towns
Nigeria's vultures face severe decline from poisoning, habitat loss and trade, but community-led conservation shows recovery is possible
All African vulture species have already become extinct
Religious traditions are the only cause of declining vulture numbers
tasks.correct_answer: Nigeria's vultures face severe decline from poisoning, habitat loss and trade, but community-led conservation shows recovery is possible
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה משלבת את המשבר הרחב באוכלוסיות הנשרים עם הדוגמה המעודדת של הגנה קהילתית באווקה־אטיטי.

tasks.prompt: Why are vultures protected in Awka-Etiti?
options: They are kept in a commercial zoo
They are considered sacred around a shrine, and residents also organise protection against hunters
They are trained to carry messages
The government pays every household that owns one
tasks.correct_answer: They are considered sacred around a shrine, and residents also organise protection against hunters
tasks.explanation_hebrew: באווקה־אטיטי מסורת מקומית רואה בנשרים יצורים מקודשים ליד המקדש, ובמקביל הקהילה פועלת נגד ציידים.

tasks.prompt: What does “scavenging” mean in the description of vultures?
options: Building nests inside houses
Hunting healthy livestock in groups
Travelling across national borders
Feeding on dead animals and other decaying material
tasks.correct_answer: Feeding on dead animals and other decaying material
tasks.explanation_hebrew: scavenging הוא חיפוש ואכילה של פגרים וחומר אורגני מת, התפקיד הטבעי המזוהה עם נשרים.

tasks.prompt: What change was reported in Awka-Etiti's vulture population?
options: It rose from about 20 birds in 2017 to more than 160
It fell from 160 birds to fewer than 20 in one month
It stayed fixed at exactly 100 birds
It recovered only after all residents left the town
tasks.correct_answer: It rose from about 20 birds in 2017 to more than 160
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הספירה המקומית עלתה מכ־20 נשרים בשנת 2017 ליותר מ־160 בעקבות מאמצי ההגנה.

tasks.prompt: Why can the loss of vultures increase risks to human health?
options: Vultures normally pollinate cocoa plants
Without them, carcasses remain longer and can support the spread of diseases such as anthrax or rabies
Vultures produce medicines used in hospitals
Their feathers prevent flooding
tasks.correct_answer: Without them, carcasses remain longer and can support the spread of diseases such as anthrax or rabies
tasks.explanation_hebrew: נשרים מסלקים פגרים במהירות; היעלמותם משאירה מקור למחלות זואונוטיות ועלולה להגדיל סיכון לבני אדם ולבעלי חיים.

tasks.prompt: What does “catastrophic” mean when the article discusses losing eggs or breeding birds?
options: Extremely harmful or disastrous
Useful for population growth
Easy to reverse within days
Unrelated to survival
tasks.explanation_hebrew: catastrophic פירושו הרסני מאוד; אובדן ביצים או בוגרים מתרבים חמור במיוחד במין שמתרבה לאט.

tasks.prompt: Identify three major threats to vultures mentioned in the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שלושה איומים שונים ולהבהיר בקצרה כיצד הם פוגעים באוכלוסייה.
expected_points: Hunting and trafficking for ritual or belief-based uses
Removal of eggs or breeding adults

tasks.prompt: Summarise why vultures matter, why they are declining and how Awka-Etiti offers a possible model for recovery.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לשלב תפקיד אקולוגי, איומים מרכזיים, והצעדים הקהילתיים שהובילו להתאוששות מקומית.
expected_points: Vultures rapidly remove carcasses and help limit disease
African populations have fallen sharply because of poisoning, trade and habitat pressures
Awka-Etiti combines sacred tradition with organised community protection
Local leadership, security teams and bylaws helped the population grow

tasks.prompt: Why might cultural beliefs be both a threat to vultures and a tool for conserving them?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את הניגוד בין ביקוש לחלקי נשרים לצורכי אמונה או טקס לבין מסורות המחשיבות את העופות קדושים ומונעות פגיעה בהם.
expected_points: Belief-based demand can encourage hunting and illegal trade
High prices for dead birds create incentives for traffickers
In Awka-Etiti, sacred status discourages residents from harming vultures
Conservation campaigns can work with respected cultural and community leaders

tasks.prompt: Design a conservation strategy for vultures in Nigeria based on the evidence in the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציע אסטרטגיה רב־מערכתית הכוללת הגנה מקומית, אכיפה, חינוך ומעקב, ולהסביר מדוע כל מרכיב נחוץ.
expected_points: Support community guardians and local leaders
Enforce wildlife laws against hunters and traffickers, including across borders
Reduce poisoning and promote safe carcass management
Explain vultures' role in controlling disease and maintaining ecosystems
